title: Golden Son
author: Pierce Brown
summary: Book two of Red Rising. A low-born rebel working inside the ruling caste of a colonised solar system is drawn into rivalries and warfare among the elite he has infiltrated.
readIf: you loved the first book and want the story to widen into warfare, alliances and betrayals.
skipIf: you have not read Red Rising, since this book assumes you know its premise.

pairings.reason: A gifted young person is pushed through brutal, escalating training by a system that treats him as a weapon, much as Darrow is.
Shares the shifting alliances, shocking deaths and ruthless dynastic politics, in a fantasy setting.
A younger, simpler story of a lower-caste hero pushed to rebel against a cruel ruling class.
